transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care, my name is Megan. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Megan, my name is Ian Fletcher. I pay for your Family Share eighty-gigabyte multi-SIM plan, but my fourteen-year-old son's secondary SIM card has zero mobile data active today and cannot access the shared pool!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Ian. I can inspect your family data sharing group and SIM card provisioning. Before we access your mobile account, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 73 Queens Road, Bristol, BS8 1QP, and my security PIN is 4491. My primary mobile account number is SN-220194.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Ian, that confirms your account details. What happens on your son's mobile phone when he attempts to open an internet web page or app?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It displays a network splash banner stating 'Your line has no active data allowance assigned. Please contact the primary account holder.' because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what has occurred is that while your Family Share account holds eighty gigabytes of pooled cellular data, your son's secondary mobile line was omitted from the automated bucket distribution, leaving his handset without mobile internet access, is that right in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what happened! Megan, my fourteen-year-old son is stranded alone at Bristol Temple Meads train station right now in the pouring rain! His train was cancelled, his digital train ticket is locked in his phone wallet app that requires data to refresh, and he cannot call an Uber to get home! I am beside myself with panic so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I query our mobile virtual network operator group pooling module across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Ian. I have pulled up your family group hierarchy. The monthly shared data replenishment script failed to allocate a secondary allowance quota to SIM profile 07700 900518 to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you allocate twenty gigabytes to his line right now so he can load his ticket and message me so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am opening the manual quota redistribution tool right now in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How quickly does the data become usable on his handset since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The network data bearer attaches to the handset within sixty seconds of committing the quota command across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please execute it immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have allocated a thirty-gigabyte dedicated share allowance directly to SIM profile 07700 900518 to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me call him on his mobile right now to see if his 5G icon connects since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ask him to toggle aeroplane mode on and off to refresh the cellular data attachment in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: He is toggling aeroplane mode now... Megan! He says the 5G icon just popped up! His digital ticket refreshed and he was able to book his train home because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the cellular data bearer is fully active and authenticated on his handset across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What a tremendous relief! He is getting on the five-forty train now. Thank goodness so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously family sharing pools require active device quota flags assigned in the primary billing container to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why did your automated monthly script omit his SIM in the first place since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A billing platform batch migration occurred last weekend which caused secondary SIM flags to default to zero quota.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please ensure that bug does not strip his data again on the next billing date.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have locked the recurring monthly allocation to thirty gigabytes for his line permanently.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will ensure he always has thirty gigabytes ready on the first of every month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The remaining fifty gigabytes of your eighty-gigabyte pool will remain assigned to your primary line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That distribution is ideal for our family needs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can also adjust individual member data limits dynamically at any time using the My S-Net mobile application.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will use the app if we ever need to reallocate data during school holidays.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have applied a ten-pound goodwill credit to your mobile account for the disruption caused today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Megan, that is very generous and appreciated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The ten-pound credit will automatically discount your next direct debit invoice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will look out for that on next month's bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our mobile customer care team is available twenty-four hours a day for any emergency account issues.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is reassuring to know support is open around the clock.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The secondary SIM profile will maintain full UK roaming and EU data access.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will be useful when he visits relatives in France next summer.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude our call, that son's secondary mobile phone number was 07700 900518, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have allocated the thirty-gigabyte share allowance, verified his 5G restoration, locked the recurring quota, and applied the ten-pound goodwill credit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything is completely sorted. My son is safe and on his way home.
